'''K4X4''' was a [[K4 security droid]] owned by the [[black marketeer]] [[Suraya]]. The droid was purchased to protect Suraya from reprisals by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="J15" />
